finding_responses.fix: Added telegram.BotNotFoundError, converted TDLib 400 "Username not found" on SearchPublicChat, mapped it to codes.NotFound, and added repo + gRPC tests through ResolveBot.

Applied FloodWaitFromError to Repo.GetMessage, Repo.GetChatHistory, Repo.SendMessage, and Repo.SendBotStartMessage; preserved SendMessageAndWait behavior by deriving retry delay from the typed error; added mocked-adapter 7.5s tests for all four wrappers and updated the warmup 429 assertion.

Enforced the 10s handler deadline with a goroutine and select over the buffered callback result and ctx.Done(); timeout returns DeadlineExceeded and in-flight TDLib results are discarded. Replaced the mock-supplied-error test with a testing/synctest virtual-time test. Select race hardened: both branches check callCtx.Err() and prioritize DeadlineExceeded/Canceled over a late result; synctest fake returns a plain late TDLib error and still asserts DeadlineExceeded. Callback tests were rerun with -count=20.
GetBotInfo now treats nil/missing fullInfo.BotInfo as TargetNotBotError; added facade and transport negative tests mapping to FailedPrecondition.

files.intent: Add the approved five-RPC bot menu surface, request/response messages, and InlineButton oneof.
Regenerated Go bindings using the verified protoc/plugins command.
Regenerated gRPC service bindings using the verified protoc/plugins command.

Add SearchPublicChat, GetUser, GetUserFullInfo and SendBotStartMessage adapters, apply flood-wait conversion to the five new TDLib paths, and convert callback failures to the semantic typed error. Convert username-not-found and flood-wait errors on bot-menu call paths; wrappers now include GetMessage, GetChatHistory, SendMessage, and SendBotStartMessage.

Add FloodWaitError/FloodWaitFromError reusing parseFloodWait, plus CallbackAnswerError for callback 4xx/502 semantics. Add BotNotFoundError for TDLib username-not-found and existing FloodWaitError/CallbackAnswerError typed errors.
Add five thin wrapper methods, latest-message lookup, bot validation, callback payload construction and /start deep-link routing. Return TargetNotBotError when GetUserFullInfo has no BotInfo.
Add semantic TargetNotBotError and MessageNotFoundError for new bot-menu paths only.

Extend facadeService, add five handlers, raw TDLib-to-proto mapping, callback validation and new typed-error gRPC status mapping. ClickCallbackButton now applies callbackAnswerTimeout and context deadlines map to DeadlineExceeded. Map BotNotFoundError to NotFound and enforce callback timeout with goroutine/select; in-flight TDLib result is discarded on timeout.
Hand-added new facadeService methods using existing mockery v3 testify style; no regeneration was run.
Hand-added new telegramRepo methods using existing mockery v3 testify style; no regeneration was run.
Hand-added new clientAdapter methods so existing package tests compile with the widened adapter interface.
Cover 7-second retry-after conversion to 7.5s and non-flood passthrough.
Strict-mock tests proving the five wrappers build expected TDLib requests and semantic errors. Add non-bot GetBotInfo negative test.

Cover inline/bot-info/callback mappings, latest-menu request, validation, and error mapping including RetryInfo details. Add username-not-found gRPC status, non-bot GetBotInfo status, and testing/synctest callback deadline test.
Add pinned proto plugin installation and regeneration command; protoc 34.x must be on PATH.
Record the required manual live bot-menu acceptance steps.
Document the five new gRPC methods following existing package convention.
Document bot-menu wrappers and no-reply-wait boundary following existing package convention. Clarify synchronous callback answer is distinct from reply waiting.
Document new TDLib wrappers and typed bot-menu errors following existing package convention. Correct bot-menu wrapper and typed-error documentation after flood-wait conversion.

Pin the callback server-deadline contract by observing the deadline context and asserting DeadlineExceeded without sleeping. Add username-not-found gRPC status, non-bot GetBotInfo status, and testing/synctest callback deadline test.
Preserve SendMessageAndWait retry semantics when SendMessage returns typed FloodWaitError.
Update the 429 warmup assertion for the now-typed FloodWaitError result.
Cover TDLib username-not-found through SearchPublicChat and retry-after 7 → 7.5s through four wrappers using mocked clientAdapter.
